title: Cost-Share Percentage on the Line of a Decided Late-Filing Reconsideration — Appeals and Grievances Training Sheet
content:
**Appeals and Grievances training sheet: the cost-share percentage on the case's line**

This sheet covers a formal review asked for on a decided Claim Factual Reconsideration of a TRICARE Select line denied for late filing.

**Rule.** The cost-share percentage on the case's line follows the provider's network status recorded on it and the schedule of the tier the case's line was billed under: from a non-network provider it is that tier's non-network outpatient percentage; a network line for preventive care carries none; any other network line carries that tier's network outpatient percentage, which is none on a tier that charges fixed network copayments.

The tier is the TRICARE Select tier of the enrollment the line was billed under, and the percentages are that tier's figures in the TRICARE Select schedule. "Non-network" covers a provider recorded on the line as non-network, participating or nonparticipating; "network" is a provider recorded on the line as network.

*Does a non-network provider's preventive care line carry a percentage?* Yes. Only a network line for preventive care carries none; from a non-network provider the line carries the tier's non-network outpatient percentage whatever its class.

*A network primary care line under a tier with a hypothetical 20 percent network outpatient percentage?* 20 percent.

*A network line under a tier that charges fixed network copayments?* That tier's network outpatient percentage is none, so no percentage applies.

| Network status recorded on the line | Service class | Cost-share percentage |
|---|---|---|
| non-network (participating or nonparticipating) | any | the tier's non-network outpatient percentage |
| network | preventive care | none (0) |
| network | any other class | the tier's network outpatient percentage (none on a tier that charges fixed network copayments) |
